title: Toward Generative Quantum Utility via Correlation-Complexity Map
summary: We study a practical question in generative quantum machine learning: given a classical dataset, can we determine, before training, whether it is well suited to a quantum generative model? We focus on a class of quantum circuits known as instantaneous quantum polynomial-time (IQP) circuits, whose output distributions are widely believed to be difficult to sample from using classical methods. These circuits are used to build our quantum generative models. We introduce a Correlation-Complexity Map, a simple diagnostic built from two quantities computed from data samples.
